model_claims.text: Custom multipart boundaries such as `part:boundary` are legal delimiter values, but they must be quoted in the Content-Type parameter.
model_claims.source_quote: Custom multipart boundaries such as `part:boundary` are legal delimiter values, but they must be quoted in the Content-Type parameter.

model_claims.text: Currently the body contains `--part:boundary` while a MIME parser reads the unquoted header as `boundary=part`, so it cannot find the form parts.
model_claims.source_quote: Currently the body contains `--part:boundary` while a MIME parser reads the unquoted header as `boundary=part`, so it cannot find the form parts.

model_claims.text: Quote boundary values that are not HTTP tokens.
model_claims.source_quote: Quote boundary values that are not HTTP tokens, leaving generated boundaries and ordinary token values unchanged.

model_claims.text: Leave generated boundaries and ordinary token values unchanged in the Content-Type header.
model_claims.source_quote: Quote boundary values that are not HTTP tokens, leaving generated boundaries and ordinary token values unchanged.

model_claims.text: For each of the eight boundary characters that require quoting, the standard library MIME parser fails to recover the original boundary, field name and value before the fix.
model_claims.source_quote: The regression uses the standard library MIME parser to recover the original boundary, field name and value for all eight boundary characters that require quoting. All eight cases fail before the fix.

model_claims.text: Token and generated-boundary controls retain their previous Content-Type representation.
